About Zapier

Zapier is the leader in easy automation, helping businesses automate workflows and move data across over 9,000 apps. We work with what you work with, across your apps and tech stack, so you can make magic happen, regardless of your IT infrastructure.

We power over 3.4 million businesses, from startups to Fortune 100 companies, and we’ve been doing it for over a decade. We’re 800+ people across 40 countries, committed to advancing the way everyone gets stuff done, so automation can truly work for everyone.

Zapier was founded in 2012 by Wade Foster, Mike Knoop, and Bryan Helmig.

Nearly 8,000 partners integrate with Zapier, more than any other automation platform.

We’ve been a fully remote team from day one, and today we’re distributed across 40 countries.

Over 3.4 million businesses use Zapier to automate their critical workflows.

Zapier users have created more than 25 million automated workflows, called Zaps.

Zapier raised $1.3 million in 2012. Without any further funding, we were valued at $5 billion in 2021.
